definition: SOG = a legal attacking shot, tip, or deflection that scores or would enter the goal if not stopped by the goalkeeper. Exclude wide/high attempts, post/crossbar-only attempts, skater blocks, harmless passes, goalie collection of wide balls, and disallowed goals. Count a distinct rebound shot separately. Unknown outcome or on-target path is not confirmed SOG.

evaluation.reference: Published Astra predictions are a comparator, not ground truth. Existing official NJ goals with assistant-reviewed timestamps are a limited sanity check only.

failure_policy: Persist costs and statuses. No automatic retries of ambiguous requests. Missing windows are never counted as zero.
cost_scope: API usage with standard rates and a separate conservative input multiplier of1.25 for comparison to previous reports. Modal compute/storage excluded. Matched-context evaluation cost is separate from independent pipeline cost.
